title: Filter
description: Removes the highs (lowpass), the lows (highpass), everything but a band (bandpass) or a narrow band (notch) of a sound around a cutoff frequency, with a gentle or steep slope, with optional resonance, and can move the cutoff with an LFO (free or tempo-synced) for a wobble. Takes audio and gives audio.

inputs.name: region
inputs.title: Region in
inputs.description: A region (the joins of a loop) to process instead of audio. The result stays a region: it never reaches an audio input, only a region-merge block turns it back into audio.

outputs.name: region
outputs.title: Loop seam
outputs.description: The processed region. Connect it to another effect or to a region-merge block.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the sound through untouched (bypass).

parameters.name: type
parameters.doc: lowpass removes the highs, highpass the lows, bandpass keeps only a band around the cutoff, notch removes a narrow band around the cutoff. Resonance narrows the band of bandpass and notch (a notch at 0 is wide).

parameters.name: slope
parameters.doc: How steeply the filter cuts, in dB per octave: 12 is gentle, 24 is two filters in a row, 36 three and 48 four (steeper, no more than that). 12 keeps older songs unchanged.

parameters.name: cutoff
parameters.doc: Where the filter works. With an oscillator it is the lowest point of the swing.

parameters.name: resonance
parameters.doc: A peak at the cutoff that makes the filter ring and sing (0 is none, 100 is about +18 dB; high values on a sweep give the classic acid sound). Above 0 the filter has two poles; at 0 it is the plain two-stage filter of older songs. Can be automated like the cutoff: auto(1:0, 9:90) or a control.

parameters.name: lfo_rate
parameters.doc: Locks an oscillator to the tempo and moves the cutoff with it (the wobble): a note value, 1/8 is eight swings a bar, a t is a triplet. Off keeps the cutoff still. Also written lfo_sync, like "sync" on the tremolo.
parameters.label: LFO sync

parameters.name: lfo_depth
parameters.doc: How far the oscillator lifts the cutoff above its lowest point, in octaves (0 is no swing).

parameters.name: lfo_shape
parameters.doc: The shape of the swing: sine and triangle are smooth, saw rises and drops, square jumps between the two.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).
